content: 1 A song of degrees. Beholde, praise ye the Lorde, all ye seruants of the Lord, ye that by night stande in the house of the Lord. 2 Lift vp your hands to the Sanctuarie, and praise the Lord. 3 The Lorde, that hath made heauen and earth, blesse thee out of Zion.
